problem: Consider the standard basis ${i,j}$ of ${R}^{2}.$ If $T$ is a linear transformation such that $T(i)=i$ and $T(j)=1.5i+j,$ then what is the geometric interpretation of the transformation $T?$

choices.value: A stretch of scale factor $1.5$ in the $x$-direction
A stretch of scale factor $1.5$ in the $y$-direction
A stretch of scale factor $2.5$ in the $y$-direction
A vertical shear with a shear factor of $1.5$
A horizontal shear with a shear factor of $1.5$

activity_context.topic_title: Shear and Stretch as Linear Transformations
